title: Tog yk's cards
description: This mod add playing cards to the game
body:
This mod adds a simple and immersive way to bring card games into Minecraft. Collect playing card sets in multiple color variants, and place your cards in card holders crafted from different wood types. Place cards as neat piles. Perfect for a game of cards with your friends, taverns, casinos, or any build that could use a deck of cards.


## Features:

### Cardboxes:
- Can be opened by right clicking the air.
- Can be placed: if it is placed when it is open it will place all the cards inside instead. (crouch for the cards to be placed face up)
- Come in all dye variants and gold.
- Contains a standard deck of cards with 2 jokers

### Cardpiles:
- Can be interacted with to grab the top card
- Can be placed. (crouch for the cards to be placed face up)
- Can be shuffled by right clicking the air.

### Cards:
- Can be placed. (crouch for the cards to be placed face up)

### Card Holders:
- Cards can be placed on an holder. The placed card will be placed in the most right position.
- Can be interacted to grab the most right card.
- Come in all wood variants.

### Recipes
- Cardboxed can be made with 3 paper and a dye or golden ingot.
- Cardholders can be made with 3 wooden slabs in a row.

## Planned Features
- Gui for the cardholder and cardpile to grab a specific card
- Table cloth where you can place card and holders in a less restricted way
- Throwing cards
- Game shelf
